name: showreel-c3-green-sahara

voice.text: Was the Sahara always a desert? 10,000 years ago, it was green, with lakes and rivers. Hippos and crocodiles lived where there is only sand today. People herded cattle there, and painted them on rocks. The cause is a slow wobble of the Earth. It can pull the summer rains far to the north. About 5,000 years ago, they moved south, and it dried up. Turns out, the Sahara turns green about every 20,000 years.

caption:
The Sahara wasn't always sand. 10,000 years ago it had lakes, hippos and crocodiles, and a slow wobble of the Earth is why it dried up. 🐊🌍

Send this to someone who thinks deserts are forever. Which place should we explain next? 👇
